name: Hotel Fernblick Tirol
beschreibung: The Hotel Fernblick Tirol is located in the municipality of Fiss in the Tiroler Oberland. The location of the hotel allows a wide view of the mountains. The surroundings are shaped by the nature of the Alpen and offer hiking trails and the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis ski area. The amenities include a wellness area and a restaurant. The atmosphere is quiet and geared toward relaxation. Guests use the hotel as a base for outdoor activities.
